summary: Hard-cut one production Liepin details browser operation (open/wait/capture) behind the existing authenticated, journaled supervised sidecar Source Execution Port; force continuation through the same details operation.
rationale: After the cards hard-cut, main still owns detail open/wait/capture and continuation browser effects against the same WTSCLI profile. Splitting the new details route from deletion would leave a direct production browser bypass or two competing correctness authorities. Continuation must not keep a separate direct browser path.
deletion_targets: main-process direct detail open/wait/capture/URL-probe routes to WTSCLI and Chrome
main-process continuation expand browser bypass that does not use the details Source Port
main-side reason-code-driven automatic detail open replay as a competing correctness authority
sidecar-local reason-code automatic detail open retry within one authorization
production fallback that keeps main as a second Liepin browser-effect owner for details
sidecar writes of main product state such as collected-resumes
line_count_rationale: liepin_site_adapter.py remains the existing oversized browser-effect owner and receives only the details Source Port effect/ingest wiring for this hard cut. Splitting that module is a separate refactor outside this operation migration.
verification: uv run --group dev python -m pytest -q -p no:tach tests/test_liepin_details_source_operation.py tests/test_liepin_cards_source_operation.py tests/test_source_port_command_journal.py tests/test_runtime_control_source_operations.py tests/test_runtime_control_source_reconciliation.py tests/test_source_port_history_contract.py tests/test_source_port_authenticated_history_frames.py
uv run --group dev ruff check src tests experiments tools
uv run --group dev ty check src tests tools
uv run --group dev python tools/check_privacy_gate.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_agent_safety_gate.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_ai_bad_smells.py --base origin/main
uv run --group dev python tools/check_pr_governance.py --base origin/main
risks: A transport timeout after browser dispatch must reconcile history instead of repeating the browser effect.
A stale executor, profile generation, dispatch epoch, or sidecar generation must not commit a late observation.
Terminal and partial payloads must remain outside the compact command journal and bind through immutable artifact references.
Continuation expand must call the same details Source Port; any retained direct open/wait/capture bypass reintroduces dual ownership.
Sidecar must not write collected-resumes or other main product state; main ingests only after artifact identity validation.
DetailOpenClaim must follow effect_posture; unknown must not auto-repeat open, and not_attempted must release without recording an open attempt.
Direct installed-WTSCLI verify_session must remain the only intentional main browser-effect exception.
Extension idleDeadlineAt close authority must not move into SeekTalent.
